# Advance Software

> Software engineering, data & AI systems — plus Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business
> Central development — for businesses in Fiji, the Pacific, Australia and beyond.
> Built to global standards. No hype. Just what works.

Advance Software builds custom systems, AI and automation wired into the tools
businesses already run. Services: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
development (upgrade-safe AL extensions, Copilot and AI agents, Power BI /
API / Copilot Studio & MCP integrations); AI systems grounded in the client's
own data (knowledge search with sources shown, research & drafting systems,
customer-service agents); automation & integration (document capture and
routing, integrations that end re-keying, automated reporting); and data &
dashboards (one source of truth, live sales/stock/cash answers, forecasting).

The business is led by a hands-on Software Engineer with global experiences in
Microsoft Dynamics Business Central, Systems, Data & AI (Microsoft Certified:
Azure AI Engineer Associate). Delivering to global standards. First step for
prospective clients: a free 30-minute AI strategy call.
